content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(CDR-007 Trivy Image and IaC Critical Findings Surfaced) AND XQL(CDR-007 kube-bench CIS Benchmark Failures Surfaced) AND XQL(CDR-007 Kubescape NSA CISA Hardening Gaps Surfaced) AND XQL(CDR-007 Bulk Secret Pattern File Reads During Sweep) AND XQL(CDR-007 Cloudsplaining IAM Privilege Escalation Paths Surfaced)
rules.name: Container & Kubernetes Posture Coverage — Full Supply-Chain & Hardening Sweep

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-007 Privileged Container Exec into EKS Workload) OR BIOC(CDR-007 IAM GetAccountAuthorizationDetails Bulk Enumeration) — promotes the posture sweep to a runtime-discovery incident when the scan activity matches the same shape an attacker's container/cloud discovery would produce.
rules.name: Cluster Posture-to-Runtime — Discovery Activity Detected During Sweep
